gaps_to_add_now.statement: Bring vowed and freewill offerings at the next pilgrimage festival
gaps_to_add_now.why: Deuteronomy 12:5–6 (bring offerings to the chosen place) is attached to no record; C0571 gives the general rule from Leviticus 17.

gaps_to_add_now.statement: Bring offerings from outside the Land to the sanctuary
gaps_to_add_now.why: Deuteronomy 12:26 (take your holy things to the chosen place) is attached to no record.

gaps_to_add_now.statement: Observe the impurity laws of a menstruating woman (niddah)
gaps_to_add_now.why: Leviticus 15:19–24 is held only by the topical study S062; no itemized record.

gaps_to_add_now.statement: Sanctify the Sabbath verbally (Kiddush and Havdalah)
gaps_to_add_now.why: Exodus 20:8 ('remember the Sabbath day to keep it holy') is attached to no record.

gaps_to_add_now.statement: Appoint judges and officers in every town
gaps_to_add_now.why: Deuteronomy 16:18 is held only by the topical study S135; C0956 is the one-time appointment of Deuteronomy 1:13.

gaps_to_add_now.statement: Circumcise sons (males) on the eighth day
gaps_to_add_now.why: only the Genesis 17 record C0036 states it; Leviticus 12:3 is attached to no record.

gaps_to_add_now.statement: Divorce only by giving a written bill of divorce
gaps_to_add_now.why: Deuteronomy 24:1 describes the written bill of divorce; the only record there (C1166) states the remarriage ban.

gaps_to_add_now.statement: A non-priest must not eat terumah (holy food)
gaps_to_add_now.why: Leviticus 22:10 ('no outsider shall eat the holy thing') has no record of its own; AUD-03-22-10 states only the lodger and hired-worker clause.
only the Genesis 9:4 record C0019 (no Mosaic type) states it; Leviticus 17:10–12, 14 are attached to no record.

gaps_to_add_now.statement: Do not accept testimony from a wicked person
gaps_to_add_now.why: Exodus 23:1b (do not join the wicked as an unrighteous witness) has no record; C0216 states only the false-report clause.

duplicates_now.kind: Same passage, one record contains the other
duplicates_now.action: C0096 (12:8–9) includes the not-raw clause C0097 states. Narrow C0096 to the positive manner (roasted, with unleavened bread, bitter herbs); labels differ.

duplicates_now.kind: Same passage, one record contains the other
duplicates_now.action: C0096 (12:8–9) includes the not-boiled clause C0098 states. Narrow C0096 to the positive manner of roasting and eating; Instruction vs Law on one clause.

duplicates_now.kind: Same passage, one record contains the other
duplicates_now.action: C0391's exclusion of leavened firstfruits from the altar repeats C0389's leaven ban; narrow C0391 to the 2:12 firstfruit permission.

duplicates_now.kind: Same passage, one record contains the other
duplicates_now.action: C0391's honey exclusion repeats C0390; both cite 2:11–12. Narrow C0390 to 2:11 and C0391 to the 2:12 firstfruit-gift case.

duplicates_now.kind: Same passage, one record contains the other
duplicates_now.action: Both direct the Levites' portion from their tithe; C0884 adds 'best'. Narrow C0883 to 18:26–28 or merge; labels and classifications differ.

duplicates_now.kind: Same passage, one record contains the other
duplicates_now.action: Both cover the same execution (13:10–11); C1024 only adds who strikes first. Narrow C1025 to the sentence (13:11) or merge; labels differ.
C1122's 'prohibited treatment' is leaving the body hanging (its own note), the same act as C1120; the land clause is the rationale.

duplicates_now.kind: Same law recorded again in another passage
duplicates_now.action: Deut 6:14 repeats the first commandment's ban on other gods; fold into C0146 (Mosaic Command) as Additional Scripture; C0995 is labelled Torah Law.

duplicates_now.kind: Same law recorded again in another passage
duplicates_now.action: Num 18:9–10 restates the most-holy eating rule (every male, holy place) for guilt, sin and grain offerings; add it to C0445, C0437, C0388.

duplicates_now.kind: Same law recorded again in another passage
duplicates_now.action: Same prompt-wage law: Lev 19:13 not overnight, Deut 24:15 same day before sunset; fold Deut 24:15 into C0607 as Additional Scripture.

duplicates_now.kind: Same law recorded again in another passage
duplicates_now.action: Three records keep the Sabbath (Exodus 16:23, 31:13–17 as Torah Law; Exodus 20:10 as Mosaic Command); Exodus 20:8 itself is attached to none.

duplicates_now.kind: Same law recorded again in another passage
duplicates_now.action: Numbers 35:30 and Deuteronomy 17:6 both forbid a death sentence on one witness; one record could carry the other as Additional Scripture.

labels_now.title: The priest reexamines the skin lesion on the seventh day
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: Standing step of the priest's scall examination, not a one-off direction; siblings C0486, C0488, C0489 are Mosaic Instruction.

labels_now.title: Apply the prescribed stoning judgment for the blasphemy described in the text
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: 24:14 is the one-off order to stone Shelomith's son; same-verse C0707/C0708 are historical. Standing penalty is 24:16; re-reference there if kept as law.

labels_now.title: The priest's role when a husband suspects his wife
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: Colophon directing the priest to perform the jealousy procedure, whose steps are all Instruction; not a one-off historical direction.

labels_now.title: The Levites may eat their share as wages for service
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: Standing permission: Levites and households may eat their tithe anywhere as wages; parallels AUD-04-18-11. Not a one-off direction.

labels_now.title: Do not follow other gods
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: Deut 6:14 repeats the first commandment's ban on other gods; fold into C0146 (Mosaic Command) as Additional Scripture; C0995 is labelled Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Do not begrudge your gift to the needy
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: Attitude prohibition, not a procedure; the matching 15:7-9 prohibitions C1037, C1038, C1040 are Torah Law. C1039/C1043 deserve the same review.

labels_now.title: Do not resent releasing the Hebrew servant after the prescribed service
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: Attitude rule within the servant-release law, not a procedure; sibling C1042 (do not send him away empty-handed) is Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Israel: do not fear the enemy in the prescribed war with God's promised presence
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: Generic 'when you go to war' charge, not one-off; the rest of Deut 20 has Mosaic types. Cf. C0959 (Torah Law); Mosaic Command possible.

labels_now.title: Priest: address and encourage the army before the prescribed battle
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: The priest's address before any battle is a standing procedure, exactly like the officers' address C1093 (Mosaic Instruction).

labels_now.title: Do not seek the specified Ammonite and Moabite peace or advantage
labels_now.category: 1 · Clear correction (matches the catalogue's own sibling records)
labels_now.evidence: Perpetual prohibition ('all your days for ever') among the assembly laws C1142-C1148, all Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Remove leaven from the houses for the feast
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C0109 (Torah Law). C0105 is typed Instruction while the paired bans C0109 (no leaven in houses) and AUD-02-13-7 are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Dispose of the torn flesh by giving it to dogs
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C0214 (Torah Law): Ban on eating torn flesh and its disposal to dogs are one rule's two halves; disposal is no rite step, so Instruction is unexplained.

labels_now.title: Do not put oil on the jealousy offering
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C0418 (Torah Law). Exact parallel ban for the sinner's flour offering (C0418, Lev 5:11) is Torah Law, but this one is Instruction.

labels_now.title: Do not put frankincense on the jealousy offering
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C0419 (Torah Law). Exact parallel ban (C0419, Lev 5:11) is Torah Law, but the jealousy-offering ban is Instruction.

labels_now.title: Lend sufficient help to the needy brother
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C1037 (Torah Law). Negative counterparts C1037-C1038 are Torah Law; the positive duty is Instruction (15:8) and Command (Lev 25:35).

labels_now.title: Provide the released Hebrew servant generously from your blessing
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C1042 (Torah Law). Its negative twin C1042 (15:13) is Torah Law; the positive duty at 15:14 is Instruction.

labels_now.title: Follow the lawful judgment delivered by the appointed central priests and judge
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C1056 (Torah Law): Following the court's judgment and not turning aside are one standing rule's two forms; Instruction vs Law is unexplained.

labels_now.title: Bury the executed person the same day
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C1120 (Torah Law): 'Do not leave overnight' and 'bury the same day' are one standing rule's two forms; Instruction vs Law is unexplained.

labels_now.title: Safeguard found property until its owner claims it
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C1123 (Torah Law): Ban on disregarding vs safekeeping found property are the rule's two sides; safekeeping is a standing duty, so Instruction is unexplained.

labels_now.title: Release the mother bird when taking the permitted young
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C1127 (Torah Law). Standing rule filed as Instruction; its negative twin C1127 and comparable positive duties (C1129) are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: The man unclean through the stated nocturnal discharge: leave the military camp
labels_now.category: 2 · Positive half filed as Instruction while its negative half is Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Twin C1151 (Torah Law): 'Go outside the camp' and 'do not enter it' are one exclusion's two forms; a purity rule, not a rite step, so the labels conflict.

labels_now.title: Redeem the firstborn donkey as prescribed
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: C0118 (Instruction) cites Ex 34:20; the same verses' 'redeem firstborn sons' (C0119) is Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Leave a newborn sacrificial animal with its mother for seven days
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Lev 22:27 has no own record; only C0211 (Exod 22:29, Instruction) holds it, though offering-eligibility rules are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Offer the daily morning and evening lambs with the prescribed grain, oil and wine
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Only Instruction C0333 (Num 28:3-8 attached), while Lev 23 festival offerings (C0681, C0694, C0699) are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Priests: wash hands and feet before sanctuary entry or altar ministry
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: C0345 is Instruction despite 'perpetual statute' and 'so that they do not die'; the parallel undergarment rule C0301 (Ex 28:43) is Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Bring the two prescribed birds to the priest after recovery from the discharge
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Instruction, while the woman's parallel (AUD-03-15-29), childbirth (C0483) and metzora (C0511) offerings are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Cover the hunted animal's blood with earth
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: C0574 (Instruction) states it, but it is an everyday rule for every hunter, not a sanctuary or purification procedure.

labels_now.title: Count the seven complete weeks and fifty days to the new grain offering
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Counting reads as a standing annual observance like festival rules labelled Torah Law; catalogue treats it as procedure (Deut 16:9 attached).

labels_now.title: Take the prescribed branches and fruit for Booths
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Annual observance binding all Israel, like dwelling in booths (C0704, Torah Law), yet labelled Instruction.

labels_now.title: Count seven cycles of seven years for the Jubilee
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Count under Instruction while Jubilee rules (C0718, C0721-C0723) are Torah Law; arguably procedural, flagged for review.

labels_now.title: Sound the Jubilee proclamation on the appointed Day of Atonement
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Jubilee shofar proclamation under Instruction while the Jubilee ordinance (C0718) is Torah Law; arguably procedural, flagged for review.

labels_now.title: Have a non-sacrificial vowed animal valued by the priest
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Valuation itself is Instruction C0743; Torah Law C0744 covers only the added fifth. Person and field valuations (C0740, C0747) are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Have a consecrated house valued by the priest
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Valuation itself is Instruction C0745; Torah Law C0746 covers only the added fifth. Person and field valuations are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Aaron and sons: bless Israel with the appointed words and God's name
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Standing priestly duty under Instruction (Commission AUD-05-10-8 also names blessing); comparable priestly duty C0846 (trumpets) is Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Offer the additional Sabbath lambs with the prescribed accompaniments
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Only Instruction C0928; festival additional offerings are Torah Law (C0694, C0696, C0699), so labelling is inconsistent.

labels_now.title: Offer the prescribed new-moon burnt and sin offerings with their accompaniments
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Only Instruction C0929; festival additional offerings are Torah Law elsewhere, so labelling is inconsistent.

labels_now.title: Offer the prescribed Weeks burnt and sin offerings with their accompaniments
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Only Instruction AUD-04-28-27; Torah Law C0687 covers the Lev 23:18-19 loaves offerings, which Maimonides counts under P46.

labels_now.title: Write God's words on doorposts and gates
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Standing household rule like tassels (C0860, Torah Law), yet C0991 is Mosaic Instruction.

labels_now.title: Deposit the third-year produce tithe locally for Levites, resident foreigners, orphans and widows
labels_now.category: 3 · Standing observance filed as Instruction while comparable ones are Torah Law
labels_now.evidence: Standing poor-relief rule like gleanings (C0601, Torah Law), yet C1034 is Mosaic Instruction.

labels_now.title: Ruler: write the prescribed copy of the law from the priests' text

labels_now.title: Administer judicial lashes under supervision in proportion to the offense

labels_now.title: Make no covenant with the Canaanite peoples or their gods

labels_now.category: 4 · Conquest-era bans split between Torah Law and historical directions
labels_now.evidence: C0244 (with Ex 34:12, 15) is a historical direction; the seven-nations judgment AUD-05-20-17 is typed Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Carry out the stated removal judgment against the specified Canaanite inhabitants

labels_now.category: 4 · Conquest-era bans split between Torah Law and historical directions

labels_now.evidence: Standing marriage prohibition filed as historical direction; comparable assembly restrictions (23:3-4, C1143-C1144) are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Apply the devotion judgment to the seven named nations

labels_now.title: Carry out the prescribed judgment against Amalek after the stated rest
labels_now.suggest: One label for all six (now historical direction)
labels_now.category: 4 · Conquest-era bans split between Torah Law and historical directions
labels_now.evidence: Standing judgment filed as historical direction while the parallel seven-nations judgment AUD-05-20-17 is Torah Law; arguably a one-time charge.

labels_now.evidence: C0150 is typed Command; the companion false-oath ban of Lev 19:12 (C0604) is Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Perform your ordinary labour during the six working days

labels_now.evidence: Exodus 20:3–17 are all filed as Mosaic Command; their parallels in Leviticus 19 and 26 are Torah Law.

labels_now.evidence: Exodus 20:3–17 are all filed as Mosaic Command; their parallels in Leviticus 19 and 26 are Torah Law.

labels_now.title: Do not commit adultery

labels_now.title: Do not steal

labels_now.title: Do not murder

labels_now.category: 5 · Ten Commandments filed as Mosaic Command (a convention choice)

rows613_now.statement: Know (believe) that God exists
Believe that God is One
Love God
Fear God
Serve God through daily prayer
Cleave to God (by associating with Torah sages)
Swear by God's name when an oath is required
Walk in God's ways by imitating His attributes
Sanctify God's name publicly (kiddush Hashem)
Recite the Shema morning and evening
Study Torah and teach it
Wear tefillin on the head
Bind tefillin on the arm
Wear fringes (tzitzit) on four-cornered garments
Affix God's words (mezuzah) to doorposts and gates
Assemble the people to hear the law every seventh year
The king must write a Torah scroll for himself
Every Israelite must write a Torah scroll
Bless God after eating (grace after meals)
Build a sanctuary for God
Revere the sanctuary
Guard the sanctuary (Levitical watch)
Levites perform their service in the sanctuary
Priests wash hands and feet before sanctuary service
Kindle the sanctuary lamps daily
Priests bless Israel with the priestly blessing
Arrange the showbread and frankincense before God weekly
Burn incense on the golden altar every morning and evening
Keep a fire burning continually on the altar
Remove ashes from the altar daily
Send the ritually impure out of the camp (sanctuary)
Honour the priest and treat him as holy
Priests wear the priestly garments during their service
Carry the ark on the shoulders
Prepare the holy anointing oil
Priestly courses serve in rotation, all equally at festivals
A priest must defile himself for close relatives (mourning)
The high priest must marry a virgin
Offer the two daily (tamid) lambs
The high priest offers a meal offering every morning and evening
Bring the additional Sabbath offering
Bring the additional new-moon offering
